'''House Rist Bunker''' was a military installation of [[House Rist]] located in the [[Juran Mountains/Legends|Juran Mountains]] on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. Around the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3643 BBY]], [[Andra Cressen]] was held inside the bunker.
